name: domains
description: Domain portfolio, registrar, marketplace, and DNS management for AI agents. Four surfaces: CLI (domains), MCP (domains-mcp), HTTP API (domains-serve), and a generated SDK (@hasna/domains/sdk). Without HASNA_DOMAINS_DATABASE_URL the serve uses SQLite at ~/.local/share/open-domains/domains.db; with the URL set it reads/writes PostgreSQL directly (PURE REMOTE per Amendment A1 — no cache or sync in the service). The data backend is the only runtime switch.

serve.auth: api-key (@hasna/contracts) — header x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer
